newsitem.title: USA: ITT board clause may help fight Hilton -WSJ.
newsitem.headline: ITT board clause may help fight Hilton -WSJ.

text.p: A clause in ITT Corp's articles of incorporation allowing it to expand its board could help the company fight the $6.5 billion hostile bid from Hilton Hotels, the Wall Street Journal said Friday.

According to the paper, the clause lets ITT "prevent any shareholder from obtaining majority representation on the board of directors by increasing the size of the board and filling the newly created directorships with its own nominees."
The clause allows the company's board, which now has 11 directors, to expand the number of directors to as many as 25.
The paper said Hilton is aware of the clause and has hired former White House counsel Bernard Nussbaum and other attorneys to block such a move.
